paragraphs: DivDat Powered by Meridian sells payment processing and digital customer engagement to utilities, municipalities, healthcare organizations and other service providers. The pitch is a single platform in place of separate tools for engagement, payments, reporting and reconciliation.

Customers can pay at kiosks, on the web, by mobile, through IVR, by text or in person, without each channel being managed separately. Links to billing and finance systems run over real-time APIs, batch files or a mix of both. The company says it also handles implementation, system integration, customer support and ongoing operations.

It describes its customers as high-volume, highly regulated operations. The business began with secure payment transaction services and widened into full revenue cycle management. A leadership team is listed covering payments, integrations, operations and customer support.

quote.text: One Platform. Every Channel. Total Visibility.
